clauses.clause: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
clauses.evidence: Target slot (cast): 1..1 of [you_bear, you_giant] (own creatures only). you_bear: counters {} -> {'PLUS_1_PLUS_1': 1}, 2/2 -> 3/3; you_giant 4/4 -> 5/5.
clauses.issue: engine-limit: no priority, so the instant is cast only in its controller's action window

clauses.clause: It gains protection from the color of your choice until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: 'ask choose: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]' (five options = W, U, B, R, G, each once in the tree); the same creature gets 'keywords +PROTECTION', and 'after the turn ends: ... keywords -PROTECTION'. The colour itself is not visible in the trace: packs feat_of_resistance_pro_red.json (choice 3: opponent's red Shock refused, blue Capture Sphere allowed) PASS and feat_of_resistance_pro_white.json (choice 0: white Defiant Strike refused, red Shock allowed) PASS.
